# ARNZO PDF Toolkit

> Free, browser-based PDF tools for merging, splitting, rotating, extracting, compressing and converting PDF documents. PDF contents are processed locally in the user's browser.

- Product name: ARNZO PDF Toolkit
- Website: https://pdf.arnzo.com/
- Publisher: ARNZO
- Publisher website: https://arnzo.com/
- Product type: Free web application / PDF utilities
- Pricing: Free; no account required
- Primary language: English
- Platform: Modern desktop and mobile browsers with JavaScript enabled

## Privacy and processing
PDF files are selected from the user's device and processed client-side using browser APIs and open-source JavaScript libraries. PDF contents are not uploaded to ARNZO servers for processing. Large files may be constrained by available device memory. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts; this does not transmit PDF contents.

## Available tools
- Merge PDF: combine two or more PDF files into one PDF.
- Split PDF: export selected pages as individual PDF files inside a ZIP archive.
- Extract pages: create a new PDF containing selected pages.
- Delete pages: remove selected pages from a PDF.
- Rotate PDF: rotate all pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
- Images to PDF: create a PDF from JPG and PNG images.
- PDF to images: render PDF pages as PNG files in a ZIP archive.
- Compress PDF: rasterize pages into JPEG images at a selected quality. This does not preserve searchable text, links, forms or vector quality; output may not be smaller.

## How to use
1. Open https://pdf.arnzo.com/
2. Select a PDF tool.
3. Choose files from the device.
4. Set page ranges or quality if the selected tool asks for them.
5. Process locally and download the result.

## Important limitations
- Processing speed and maximum practical file size depend on device memory and browser performance.
- Password-protected PDFs may not be supported by all operations.
- Compression is image-based and can reduce document fidelity.
- Images to PDF currently accepts JPG and PNG.
